comment: The CDSE requirements cover fail-safe behaviour, audit logging, availability and low-connectivity degradation, but they do not require queue persistence, manual routing or post-recovery reconciliation for safety-critical workflows.

anchor.note: p.199 l.22-25 read as the printed page; section C agrees

public.text: The CDSE requirements cover fail-safe behaviour, audit logging, availability and low-connectivity degradation, but they do not require queue persistence, manual routing or post-recovery reconciliation for safety-critical workflows.
public.suggestedRevision: Require queue persistence, recovery procedures, manual routing and post-recovery reconciliation so that failed or delayed tasks cannot be silently lost during network interruption, model outage or integration failure.
